content_fields.title: Test pipeline efficiency and security (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify pipeline efficiency and security controls.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming actions are SHA-pinned, token permissions are minimal, untrusted code never runs with secrets in scope, and cache keys cannot be influenced by untrusted input.
content_fields.missing: The pipeline definitions that would be the subject of the review.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification has no subject until build automation is introduced.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should perform this review once pipelines exist.
